dataset: MODIS Aqua 8-day daytime land-surface temperature and SEDAC GPWv4 2020 population density, via NASA GIBS WMS
method: PNG pixels are converted back to data values with the exact GIBS colormaps and averaged per grid cell. Cells with >= 500 people/km2 are populated; the hottest 40% of populated cells by daytime land-surface temperature (>= 54.1 C) are heat cells. eventDay is 0 for all cells.
